    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:

            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def populate_hub_cache(repo_id, repo_type, revision, local_dir, file_patterns):
    """Copy files into HF hub cache format."""
    org, name = repo_id.split("/")
    hub_dir = Path(CACHE_DIR) / "hub" / f"{repo_type}s--{org}--{name}"
    blobs_dir = hub_dir / "blobs"
    snap_dir = hub_dir / "snapshots" / revision
